characterList.description: Elderly man with white hair, wearing glasses and a brown v-neck sweater. Nuclear scientist and science communicator formerly at the University of Paris.
characterList.name: Professor Fontes

characterList.description: Young woman with dark hair. Wears a black jacket and a white scarf in the first part of the video and a black jacket and white top in the second part.
characterList.name: Female assistant

content_metadata.description: This video demonstrates low-cost physics experiments that can be used to teach basic concepts of physics. Geared towards school teachers.

narrativeProgression.description: Professor Fontes demonstrates that the water flowing from the bottle initially has a horizontal trajectory before curving downwards.
Discusses the difference between a parabola and an ellipse, emphasizing that the observed trajectory is technically an ellipse due to the variation in the gravitational field.

Vignan Prasar & IISER, Pune present Prof Pierre Fontes who through kitchen, toys and day to day materials deconstructs the aura of science for school teachers. 
Here is a short clip on attraction & repulsion.
